verdict.rationale: Codex documents MCP client support to connect local/remote MCP servers and plugins built by third parties (e.g., Figma, browser tools) plus native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Linear, and Slack, letting an engineering lead pull external agent tools into CLI/IDE/desktop workflows. However, the deprecated MCP-server command and lack of a dedicated partner marketplace or named partner agent apps means this is more generic protocol-level extensibility than a curated partner ecosystem. Missing for 10: a documented partner/marketplace listing of third-party agent apps, independent hands-on evidence of specific partner integrations working reliably, and clarity on non-deprecated MCP tooling maturity.
